component: gas (GNU assembler from the same recovered tree)
lineage: game-compiler - Sony/Cygnus 2.9-ee-991111b (patched game default; SN parity target)
provenance: SN-distributed GNUPro/SCE source; Wayback ps2dev.sourceforge.net ee/gnu-ee-binutils-gcc-1.1.tar.gz (sha256 1f518043e252d6eda726386971d52eda26541ab936ea73a9783d73712b595f92)
role: R5900 assembler parity: the gp->absolute expansion of a relaxable load/store or la pair must produce the retail `lui base,0` + `op %lo(base)` form.
mechanism: In reorder mode the retail R5900 assembler decides at the use: a symbol whose .extern size is not yet known gets the absolute lui/<op> form, while a known-small symbol relaxes to the single %gp_rel form (the deferred pair must not be used, and md_convert_frag's expansion also has to rebuild the first word as lui). Inside a noreorder block (the compiler delay-slot pattern) the retail assembler always emits the single gp-relative form.
fidelity_probes: reorder + no .extern -> lui+op absolute; reorder + .extern before use (size 4) -> single %gp_rel; reorder + .extern after use -> absolute
noreorder delay slot (with or without .extern) -> single %gp_rel like Ps2EeAs
int/FP and la forms verified; convert-time rewrite keeps the expansion idempotent
